rules: Blue Player card for Denver. One land search box, labeled SEARCH. No anchor.
The scratch reveals the Logistics Expert companion.
While the card is in your hand, Establish Supply Lines costs 1 fewer Supply cube.
The discount does not discard the card. It lasts for later games as long as the card is held.
This card goes to the reserve when the package is opened. Denver is not on the grid yet.
notes: Card id 905. Scratched face card id 1008. Printed code P1-07b.
The card prints the action as Establish Supply Lines, plural. The Exhausted scar and the supply-line rule print Establish Supply Line, singular.
